literal: Leg sinking in marsh, jackal will kill eye not-fearing spear warrior facing elephant.
translation: In a marsh where its legs sink, even a jackal can kill a mighty elephant that fearlessly faces spear-bearing warriors.
modern: கால்கள் ஆழமாகப் புதையும் சேற்று நிலத்தில் அகப்பட்டால், வேல் ஏந்திய வீரர்களைக் கண்டும் அஞ்சாத வலிமையான யானையை ஒரு சிறிய நரி கூடக் கொன்றுவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the absolute importance of choosing the right battleground. A mighty elephant that fearlessly charges at warriors armed with spears becomes completely helpless if it gets stuck in a deep marsh. In such an unsuitable place, even a lowly, weak jackal can easily kill the great beast. The contrast between the fearless elephant and the weak jackal emphasizes that strength is useless in the wrong environment.
